meta.name: Log Quora keyword mentions to Google Sheets with SearchApi and OpenAI

name: Monitor Quora for Keyword Mentions to Google Sheets with SearchApi

nodes.name: Run Now
nodes.notes: Run on demand to pull the latest Quora mentions right now. Click Execute Workflow.

nodes.name: Schedule Daily
nodes.notes: Activate the workflow to check Quora every day at 08:00. Change or delete this if you only run manually.

nodes.name: Settings
nodes.notes: The only node you normally edit. keywords = comma-separated terms or brand names to watch on Quora. location = a Google location string, e.g. United States.

nodes.name: Build Search Queries
nodes.notes: Expands your keywords into one site:quora.com Google search per keyword per page. Raise PAGES here to scan deeper.

nodes.name: Search Quora on Google
nodes.notes: Live Google results scoped to Quora via SearchApi.io, one call per keyword per page. The site:quora.com operator lives in the query (q); depth comes from pagination.page.

nodes.name: Extract Quora Posts
nodes.notes: Reads organic_results from every page, keeps only quora.com posts, recovers the keyword from the echoed query, and removes duplicate URLs within the run.

nodes.name: Get Existing Links
nodes.notes: Reads the rows already in your sheet so we can skip posts saved on a previous day. On the first run the sheet is empty and every post counts as new. Select the same Sheet and tab as Save to Sheet.

nodes.name: Filter New Posts
nodes.notes: Drops any post whose link is already in the sheet, so each run only adds fresh Quora mentions. If there are no new posts, the run ends here with nothing appended.

nodes.name: Summarize with AI
nodes.notes: Writes a one-sentence neutral summary of each new post from its title and snippet, using gpt-4o-mini. Swap the model or prompt to change the tone or length.

nodes.name: Attach Summary
nodes.notes: Attaches each AI summary to its post and outputs the final row: date, keyword, title, summary, link.

nodes.name: Save to Sheet
nodes.notes: Appends each new Quora mention as a row. Select your Google Sheet and tab, and give it a header row: date, keyword, title, summary, link.

parameters.content:
## Monitor Quora for Keyword Mentions to Google Sheets

Watch Quora for new questions and discussions that mention your keywords or brand, so you can jump in where your product genuinely helps. Runs daily, pulls live Google results scoped to Quora via SearchApi.io, summarizes each new post with AI, and appends it to a Google Sheet.

### How it works
1. **Run Now** or **Schedule Daily** starts the run.
2. **Settings** holds the two things you edit: your keywords and your Google location.
3. **Build Search Queries** turns each keyword into a site:quora.com Google search.
4. **Search Quora on Google** fetches live results through SearchApi.io.
5. **Extract Quora Posts** flattens results into one row per post and dedupes.
6. **Get Existing Links + Filter New Posts** drop posts already in your sheet.
7. **Summarize with AI** writes a one-sentence summary of each new post.
8. **Save to Sheet** appends date, keyword, title, summary and link.

### Setup
- [ ] Install the community node @searchapi/n8n-nodes-searchapi.
- [ ] Add your SearchApi credential (free key at searchapi.io) on Search Quora on Google.
- [ ] Add your OpenAI credential on Summarize with AI.
- [ ] Create a Google Sheet with header row: date, keyword, title, summary, link.
- [ ] Connect that sheet on both Get Existing Links and Save to Sheet.
- [ ] Edit Settings: keywords (comma-separated) and location.
- [ ] Activate the workflow.

### Customization tips
Raise PAGES in Build Search Queries for more depth. Swap quora.com for reddit.com or another site to monitor a different community.

## 1. Configure
Run on demand or daily. Edit your keywords and Google location in Settings. Nothing else needs touching.

## 2. Search Quora via Google
Each keyword becomes a site:quora.com Google search through SearchApi. Results from every page are flattened into one row per post and deduped by URL.

## 3. Keep only new posts
Reads the links already in your sheet and drops any post seen before, so each daily run only adds fresh Quora mentions.

## 4. Summarize and save
AI writes a one-sentence summary of each new post, then every row (date, keyword, title, summary, link) is appended to your Google Sheet.
